title: Relay: run a service business as repeatable workflows
excerpt: Relay is for service companies that sell finished results. It defines the result, lets agents run the workflow, sends the work through human review, ships it and shows the margin on every run. webvise designed and built Relay in-house, without a client.
challenge: Service companies want AI to do production work, but they still run on tickets, spreadsheets, chats and status meetings. That makes every result hard to scope, price and audit. Agents can draft, reconcile, research and prepare deliverables. Without review gates, evidence and a view of the margin, a team either slows everything down with manual checks or ships work it cannot explain. Relay asks how a service business can run as repeatable software while people keep control of the risky steps.
solution: Relay has a landing page and an operator dashboard. The landing page explains the loop: scope the result, run the agent workflow, review at the gates, ship the work and price each run by the value delivered. The dashboard is where an operator works. It has a workflow library with prices and target margins, a delivery board for every active result and a timeline for each run with the evidence attached. It shows the health of the connectors to tools such as Slack, Notion, Linear, Stripe, QuickBooks, GitHub and Salesforce, and a margin view that shows where profit is made or lost. Every run moves through scope, production, review and delivery. Agents do the repeatable work, and operators approve the risky steps.
